teaser.title: Rooted in Uzbekistan's Finest Growing Regions
teaser.text: Nomad Agro has spent years sourcing and exporting the finest natural produce from Uzbekistan's foothill regions — where clean mountain air, fertile soil, and traditional farming methods combine to produce exceptional quality.

about.title: About Nomad Agro
about.pageSubtitle: A Tashkent-based exporter connecting Uzbekistan's finest farms with wholesale buyers worldwide.

story.title: Our Story
story.text: Founded in Tashkent, Nomad Agro was born from a deep respect for Uzbekistan's ancient agricultural traditions and a vision to connect its premium natural produce with buyers around the world. We work directly with farmers in the foothill regions — where centuries of traditional farming have been preserved by geography and tradition — to bring you products of exceptional purity and quality.

regions.title: Growing Regions
regions.text: Our products are sourced from Uzbekistan's foothill regions, where altitude, soil composition, and a continental climate create ideal conditions for growing exceptional dried fruits, nuts, and legumes.

process.title: From Farm to Export
process.text: We oversee every step: farmer partnerships, harvesting, natural drying and processing, quality inspection, packaging, and international shipping. Our team ensures your order meets the exact specifications you need.

steps.title: Partner Farms
steps.description: We work directly with partner farmers in Uzbekistan's foothill regions.

steps.title: Quality Inspection
steps.description: Every batch is inspected for grade, cleanliness, moisture, and export specifications.

steps.title: Export & Delivery
steps.description: We handle all documentation, logistics, and phytosanitary certification for your destination market.

certifications.title: Quality & Compliance
certifications.text: Our products are prepared in compliance with phytosanitary and export standards, ensuring smooth customs clearance in your destination market. We provide all required export documentation. We also hold HACCP certification and an FDA registration, and Nomad Agro is listed as an approved exporter by Chinese Customs, which allows us to export to China.
certifications.scopeValue: Wholesale trade of fruits and vegetables

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions from wholesale buyers and importers.

items.question: Where are Nomad Agro's products grown?
items.answer: Our dried fruits and nuts are grown and sourced from the foothill regions of Uzbekistan — including the Fergana Valley, Surkhandarya, and Samarkand areas — where altitude, fertile soil, and a continental climate produce exceptional natural quality.

items.question: Does Nomad Agro export internationally?
items.answer: Yes. Nomad Agro is a Tashkent-based B2B exporter supplying wholesale buyers in Europe, Russia, the United Kingdom, the United States, Azerbaijan, Belarus, China, and Georgia. We handle all export documentation, phytosanitary certificates, and logistics coordination.

items.question: How is product quality documented?
items.answer: Every batch is inspected for grade, cleanliness, and moisture, and our food safety management system is certified to ISO 22000:2018. Product specification sheets are available on request.

items.question: How do I request a price quote?
items.answer: Prices are not published online as they change daily with crop availability and market conditions. Contact us directly via email at info@nomadagro.uz, WhatsApp, or Telegram for current pricing and availability.

items.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.answer: Minimum order quantities vary by product and packaging. Please contact us to discuss your specific requirements — we work with both container-load orders and smaller wholesale quantities.

items.question: What packaging options are available?
items.answer: We offer various packaging options including 5 kg and 10 kg boxes, as well as custom packaging upon request. Contact us to discuss the best option for your market and logistics requirements.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data we collect through this website, why we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.title: Who we are
body: This website is operated by “NOMAD AGRO” LLC, 100077, Sayram Street, Passage 7, House 52, Tashkent, Uzbekistan (TIN 307 699 304). For any privacy question, email info@nomadagro.uz.

sections.title: What data we collect
body: Contact form: when you send an inquiry, we receive the details you enter — your name and email address, and optionally your company, country, product of interest and message.

Direct contact: when you write to us by email, phone, WhatsApp or Telegram, we receive the information you share in that conversation. Those services process your data under their own privacy policies.

Technical data: when you visit the website, our hosting provider automatically processes technical data such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested, to deliver the site and protect it against abuse.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: We use inquiry data only to answer your request, prepare quotes and specification sheets, and manage any business relationship that follows. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

If the EU or UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies to you, we process inquiry data to take steps at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), and technical data on the basis of our legitimate interest in running a secure website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We also comply with the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan “On Personal Data”.

sections.title: Service providers
body: Web3Forms (web3forms.com) receives contact form submissions and forwards them to our email inbox.
Vercel Inc. hosts this website and processes the technical data described above.
OpenStreetMap: the map on our contacts page is loaded from OpenStreetMap servers, which receive your IP address when the map is shown.
These providers may process data outside your country, including in the United States.

sections.title: Cookies
body: We use a single functional cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers your language choice for up to one year. We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: How long we keep your data
body: We keep inquiry data for as long as we need it to handle your request and any business relationship that follows, and longer only where the law requires it.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask us to give you access to your personal data, correct or delete it, restrict or object to its processing, or send you a copy of it. Email info@nomadagro.uz. If the GDPR applies to you, you can also complain to your local data protection authority.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed.
